claims.text: Friedman began donating his research collection to the Provincial Archives of New Brunswick in the months before his death. Archivist Joanna Aiton-Kerr told CBC the archives had received about 300 boxes -- roughly 60 metres laid end to end -- and expected several more cargo vans. This is where the primary material behind his Roswell and MJ-12 work now sits, and it is not online.

title: CBC News, 'Archivist delighted to comb through mountain of late UFO researcher's records', 13 October 2019
